The Alps-class land battleship with $$ジャミル$$ serving as captain.
Although formally a 'land battleship', it can also travel over water by hovering, so its range of action is wide.
It can carry up to six mobile suits, and its main complement was the $$ガンダムＸ$$, the $$ガンダムエアマスター$$ and the $$ガンダムレオパルド$$.
It was also the living space of pilots such as $$ガロード$$ and the others, and when $$ロアビィ$$ came to be exclusively employed by $$フリーデン$$, he had set up a relaxation room at his own expense to make the journey comfortable.
Although it was heavily damaged in the battle when $$ガロード$$ was sent off into space, the space battleship that $$ジャミル$$ and the others later obtained was given the name '$$フリーデン$$' once again.
fixes.reason: omitted subject / pronoun: the Japanese says Roybea (male) set up the room himself at his own expense (自腹で設けていた); the passive dropped the agent and the name was repeated instead of 'he' (the second ロアビィ token is therefore replaced by 'he'/'his')

fixes.new:
In the $$ＡＤＷ$$, a representative of the Peacekeeping Council of the former $$国連$$, and currently Supreme Commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
When he was representative of the Peacekeeping Council, he formed a special international rescue team that acted beyond the bounds of organization and position for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
He possesses a strong will that does not hesitate at immediate sacrifice, but voices of suspicion are also being raised over his forceful methods and his unreadable true intentions.
Also, though its truth is unconfirmed, records remain suggesting he has lived for over 200 years, and there are many mysteries surrounding him.
His true identity was one of the $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, those who touched $$クロノエイチ$$.
In order to entrust humanity's future to those who would follow, he gave up his life in the closing stages of the $$再世戦争$$.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese is ＡＤＷの元国連の平和維持理事会の代表; 元 modifies 国連 (the former UN), not the representative, and ＡＤＷ is the era, not an authority he served 'under'

fixes.new:
Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
Unlike his predecessor $$パトリック・ザラ$$, he is a moderate who sought a road to coexistence and peace with $$ナチュラル$$s. During the $$ユニウスセブン$$ drop and the fighting with the $$地球連合$$ that followed, he consistently made calm, accurate judgments and showed excellent leadership.
He is also an authority on genetic research, and it is thought that it was through that work that he came to know $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$ and $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$. There are also signs that he had anticipated from the start that $$シン$$ would manifest the SEED.
He set up $$ミーア・キャンベル$$ as a stand-in for $$ラクス・クライン$$ in an attempt to raise the fighting spirit of all of the $$プラント$$. But it came to light that behind the scenes he had plotted the assassination of $$ラクス$$ herself, and this earned him the distrust of $$キラ$$ and the others.
His ultimate aim was to build a managed society controlling humanity at the genetic level, which he called the '$$デスティニープラン$$'. After annihilating $$ロゴス$$, he declared the introduction and implementation of the plan to the world, only to be stopped by $$キラ$$ and the others, who refused a world where evolution would halt.
At the last he was shot by $$レイ#pt136$$, whom he had trusted like a son. He closed his life in the arms of $$タリア$$, who had once been his lover and toward whom he had continued to hold feelings even after they parted.
fixes.reason: omitted subject: 別れてもなお想いを寄せ続けていた is Durandal's feelings for Talia; 'for whom feelings had never faded' left the holder of the feelings unstated

fixes.new:
A $$聖天翅$$ of the $$堕天翅$$ tribe, and a frontline commander who leads the $$天翅$$s.
Although he has wings on the back of his head, in every other respect he has the appearance closest to a human among the $$堕天翅$$.
Twelve thousand years ago, he was betrothed to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the strongest of the $$守護天翅$$s. But at the end of the $$アトランディア大戦$$, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ betrayed the $$堕天翅$$ tribe, and they crossed blades as enemies. Even so, that love had still not faded, and he approached $$アポロ$$, apparently the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, again and again.
In the course of the fighting he killed $$アポロ$$'s close friend $$バロン$$, and tormented $$アポロ$$ and the others by every means, such as cunningly tempting $$シリウス$$ into switching sides. But when the $$生命の樹$$ withered and the world faced the crisis of its end, he even teleported to $$ベクタールナ$$ to try to stop it. Even then he remained out of step with $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$, but through the memories of $$セリアン$$ that $$シルヴィア$$ showed, he learned that $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ of long ago had not betrayed them but had wished for coexistence between the $$天翅$$s and humans. Once his resolve to carry on $$アポロニアス#pilot$$'s will was firm, the three of them succeeded in $$創聖合体$$ and held the shattering world together.
fixes.reason: wrong pronoun: the Head Wing (Toma) is male per the glossary research (work/glossary/research/aquarion.json 頭翅#pilot: MALE; the Japanese is gender-neutral); all she/her changed to he/his; 'his reincarnation' and 'his will' (Apollonius's) now name Apollonius by token to avoid a wrong referent after the pronoun change
